notes: S5-HVS1: entered as follow_up because the paper adopts it as an already known Galactic HVS (T:p1-b7, T:p1-b9) discovered in prior work (T:p4-b2). S301 (T:p1-b15) is a tightly orbiting S-star and a candidate captured companion, not a Galactic unbound candidate; S14, S29, and S175 (T:p2-b7, T:p3-b7) are likewise bound S-stars tested as alternative companions, and the unnamed N = 18 catalog (T:p3-b2) does not identify individual unbound candidates. No Gaia source identifier is supplied for S5-HVS1.

S5-HVS1: The paper reports for S5-HVS1 only its mass (2.35 ± 0.06 Msun), velocity, flight time (~4.8 Myr) and age (~50 Myr); of these only the velocity maps onto an eligible quantity. The value 1799 km/s is denoted v_inf, the asymptotic ejection speed after the Hills disruption. Since Sgr A* is essentially at rest in the Galactic frame, this is taken as the star's speed in the Galactic rest frame (galactocentric_rest_frame_velocity); it is not a line-of-sight velocity, so it is not recorded as radial_velocity. Mass is not among the eligible quantity identifiers and is therefore not submitted.
